scenicChapters.title: East Coast Highway 11
scenicChapters.narrative: For 36 km this is East Coast Highway 11, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Taiwan Central Cross Island Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 3275 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Hehuanshan Wuling → Puli
scenicChapters.narrative: 3275 m come off over 54 km at around 7.2%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it — brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

taiwan-central-cross-island-highway.story: A 124 km one-way ride from near Hualien City, about 2 h 02 of riding. On the way it passes Taroko Gorge, Tianxiang and Hehuanshan Wuling. The highest point is about 3,300 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.title: Wachau Danube Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 18 km this is Wachau Danube Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-traismauer-kastell-romertor-st-jo.story: From Traismauer it runs 74 km to Traismauer; allow about 1 h 17 of riding. It goes by way of Mautern - Kastell Ostbereich, St. Johann im Mauerthale - Wachtturm and back through Mautern - Kastell Ostbereich. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
